## What this changes

One-line summary.

## Why

Link to issue, or explain the motivation.

## How it was tested

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean
- [ ] `cargo test --all-features` passes
- [ ] New behaviour covered by unit / snapshot / integration tests
- [ ] Real `claude --print` smoke test through the gateway (if touching gateway/upstream/proxy_stream)

## Docs touched (if applicable)

- [ ] `ARCHITECTURE.md` updated for any module-boundary change
- [ ] `SPIKE.md` updated if a spike-level decision is being revisited
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` section updated
- [ ] `README.md` updated if user-facing command/install/UX changed

## Conventional commit prefix

`feat:` / `fix:` / `refactor:` / `docs:` / `test:` / `chore:` / `perf:` / `ci:` / `build:`
